title: Patient participation in the concept development for a psychosocial support measure for people with MCI
summary:
Little is known about how people with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) deal with their diagnosis and their risk of dementia. 
This participatory project aims to develop important objectives for a study in which a group program for MCI patients will be tested. All those affected (MCI patients, relatives, representatives of counseling centers) are part of the research team. They are involved in all project phases, including the study procedure development. They will be actively involved in the entire development process (based on Participatory Health Research, PGF).
